data.name: Ibitha
data.gender_notes: Ibitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibitha is a name derived from Sanskrit, which translates to the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is a goddess revered for her ability to bestow riches, abundance, and prosperity upon her devotees. The name Ibitha carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ibitha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
